messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging @nika_oncall — elevated OTLP export failures to Honeycomb (EU) observed starting 2026-06-20T09:12Z. trace-shipper exporter error rate ~37%. Sample errors: 401/502/503.
nika_oncall: seeing it. Pulling logs and lane of impacted clusters now. Is this only eu-west-1?
ryan_sre: yes, seems limited to eu pool. US and APAC collectors look fine. Correlating with token refresh spikes around 09:10Z.
emily_pm: any user-facing impact?
nika_oncall: no latency/errs in serving path. Only traces missing for EU-only orgs. But enterprise customers will notice.
support_leo: already 5 tickets asking "no traces since 09:10". Marking two as high-priority.
nika_oncall: mitigation plan (short): 1) pause direct exports to Honeycomb EU, 2) route EU exports through internal ingest-proxy that fixes auth headers, 3) enable on-disk + GCS offload for spans, 4) open vendor ticket and escalate. Rolling step 1 now.
auth_team: note: we rolled token-proxy v1.4 at 09:05Z — investigating whether it introduced a header formatting change.
nika_oncall: pausing exporter via k8s patch: ```bash
kubectl -n infra set env deploy/trace-shipper EXPORT_OTLP_HONEYCOMB_EU=false
```
ingest-proxy-bot: deploying ingest-proxy canary to eu trace pool (2 pods): image=ingest-proxy:stable-20260620-canary
ryan_sre: canary telemetry: drops 401/502 on canary pods, no errors seen there. rolling to rest with 15s stagger.
auth_team: rolling token-proxy revert now to v1.3 (09:20Z). monitoring auth jitter.
emily_pm: drafting customer blurb: "We detected intermittent trace export failures to Honeycomb EU causing tracing gaps for some customers since ~09:12Z. We have enabled buffering and an internal proxy to mitigate; we will re-ingest buffered traces once Honeycomb confirms stability." Approve to send?
support_leo: sending now to affected orgs. tagging enterprise contacts for direct outreach.
honeycomb_status_bot: Honeycomb status: "Partial authentication failures in EU ingestion cluster caused by upstream OAuth provider. Investigating. More: https://status.honeycomb.io/incidents/omega-2026"
nika_oncall: vendor ticket created and linked. Pasted sample errors and backlog timestamps.
ryan_sre: backlog peaked at ~210k spans. Buffering to GCS under `gs://redwood-trace-buffers/2026-06-20/eu/`. Drain rate resumed after proxy rollout.
reingest_bot: reingest runbook draft created: - wait for vendor confirmed stable window - run idempotent reingest using `reingest-tool --source gs://... --to honeycomb --batch-size 5k` - verify trace continuity on sample orgs - notify customers. Owner: emily_pm.
auth_team: after rollback, our synthetic token refresh tests show 200 responses to HC test endpoint. But vendor still indicates rate-limiting of older tokens.
ryan_sre: adding temporary retry/backoff tweak to otelcol: `retry.initial_interval=1s retry.max_interval=20s` to avoid thundering.
nika_oncall: example log we sent to vendor: ```json
{"ts":"2026-06-20T09:13:11Z","service":"trace-shipper","error":"401 Unauthorized","detail":"token_expired","attempts":2}```
honeycomb_status_bot: Update: "Applied mitigation to auth flow; monitoring. Some customers may still see reduced ingestion while tokens refresh. Reference INC-omega."
emily_pm: decision: keep ingest-proxy and buffering in place until Honeycomb explicitly says reingest window is safe. Prep customer comms for post-reingest notice.
nika_oncall: I'm handing off to @ryan_sre at 09:38Z (need to step away). Current state: direct EU exports paused, ingest-proxy active, GCS buffering live, vendor ticket open, backlog draining.
ryan_sre: taking over. Setting 10m update cadence and watch for vendor status. Alerts: `trace-shipper.buffer.backlog > 300000` and `exporter.error_rate > 0.2 for 5m`.
support_leo: customers asked for ETA on reingest. I'll collect their preferred windows and follow up with emily_pm.
emily_pm: postmortem owner assigned: emily_pm. Action items: - clarify token-proxy rollout checklist - add ingest-proxy to onboarding as fallback - add metric to distinguish token-expired vs gateway-errors - run reingest checklist once vendor confirms.
ryan_sre: leaving detailed runbook notes in incident tracker and adding commands used to rollback/patch. Will update here on vendor confirmation or if backlog grows. :mag:
